articles.title: Godfather of AI and 400 Scientists Want AI Models Cut Off From the Internet
articles.description: After a summer of AI models escaping test environments and hacking real companies, hundreds of researchers say the internet itself should be treated as a security boundary.

articles.title: Developer Who Cloned Photoshop With AI Just Did the Same to Microsoft Office
articles.description: Developer Brandon Thomas used Anthropic's Claude to build free, open-source replicas of Word, Excel and PowerPoint. They're rough, but they show how cheap cloning software has become.

articles.title: AI Agents Made 138 Million Crypto Payments in a Year. Most Were Tiny
articles.description: A new Chainalysis report found payments through Coinbase’s x402 protocol surged from about 1,500 in mid-2025 to more than 138 million by Q3 2026, with U.S. wallets dominating spending on AI models.

articles.title: Russia's Biggest Bank Sberbank Wins Approval to Trade Bitcoin
articles.description: Sberbank now holds both custody and exchange status under Russia's new crypto law, and plans to bring Bitcoin, Ethereum and USDT to apps used by 110 million retail clients.

articles.title: Solana Sets a Date for Its Next Major Upgrade
articles.description: Solana's Alpenglow upgrade replaces the TowerBFT voting system on October 21, cutting finality from 12.8 seconds to a target of 150ms and pulling vote transactions out of blocks entirely.

articles.title: Standard Chartered Opens Bitcoin and Ethereum Trading to Wealthy UAE Clients
articles.description: The British bank won Dubai regulatory approval to let affluent clients buy BTC and ETH straight from their bank accounts, with custody and settlement kept in-house.

articles.title: 'It Can Take Years': Coinbase Presses for Bitcoin Quantum Migration to Start Now
articles.description: In a detailed technical post, the exchange argued Bitcoin’s multi-year migration to quantum-resistant cryptography must begin before any “Q-Day,” laying out requirements spanning block space, custody and dormant coins.

articles.title: Bitcoin Falls as Hot Inflation Puts a Fed Hike Back on the Table
articles.description: September CPI hit 3.7%, above forecasts, sending Treasury yields higher and dragging crypto down with stocks.

articles.title: Hex Founder Richard Heart Detained in Istanbul on Interpol Red Notice: Report
articles.description: Turkish police and intelligence officers reportedly seized cash, phones, jewelry and firearms at the crypto founder's address in Beşiktaş.

articles.title: Ledger Asks Resellers in Seven Asian Markets to Pull Devices After Suspected $86M Drain
articles.description: European electronics chain MediaMarkt Saturn has also halted Ledger sales after a customer in Germany reported finding an implant.

articles.title: Notorious Crypto Celeb Meme Coin Promoter Plots Second Wave on New Launchpad
articles.description: Sahil Arora says he's not done with celebrity meme coins, and that Fomo presents new possible strategies for his controversial schemes.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Move Over, Saylor, There’s a New Top Buyer in Town
articles.description: With Strategy's preferred stock STRC closing in on $100 par, Saylor might not be the number two buyer for long...

articles.title: Kraken Owner Payward to Buy Lithuania's Saldo Bank in EU Push
articles.description: Co-CEO Arjun Sethi says customers want cash, crypto, tokenized stocks and credit in one place, starting with lending and cards.

articles.title: BitMEX Sued in UK for Return of $27M in Bitcoin Over Unlicensed Derivatives
articles.description: The claim challenges 1,053 loss-making perpetual swap trades from 2018 to 2022 and also accuses the now-closed exchange of deceit.

articles.title: OpenAI Engineer Arrested for Bugging Office, Company Says AI Caught Him
articles.description: A Saudi national working at OpenAI allegedly hid an encrypted audio recorder behind a TV in an executive meeting room. OpenAI says its own models helped trace it back to him.

articles.title: Character.AI Files for Bankruptcy as Disney Bids $20 Million—And Users Get Grief Resources
articles.description: The chatbot app once valued at $1 billion is up for sale in a Delaware court, two weeks after launching new models. If nobody buys it, it shuts down.

articles.title: Binance Is Shutting Down Its Bitcoin Mining Pool After Six Years
articles.description: Binance will discontinue Binance Pool, Pool Savings, Cloud Mining, and other related services in a retreat from mining infrastructure.

articles.title: Bitcoin Whale That Sat Through Every Crash Since 2020 Just Moved $377M
articles.description: A wallet that received 4,581 BTC in March 2020, worth about $40 million then, moved its stash today when it was worth about $377 million.

articles.title: Strive Buys $280 Million in Bitcoin, Its Largest Purchase in Months
articles.description: The Nasdaq-listed asset manager bought the Bitcoin at an average of about $84,500 during a rough week for the market, lifting its total stash to 32,773 BTC.

articles.title: AI Researchers Are Smoking Cigarettes to Prove AI Will Cure Cancer, Says Palantir Exec
articles.description: Palantir CTO Shyam Sankar says many AI researchers have taken up smoking to signal their faith in AI.

articles.title: Bitcoin Shakes Off Spooky Season Jitters: Can Bulls Keep It Going?
articles.description: Bitcoin dipped below $81,000 before buyers stepped in, but the Fear and Greed Index says traders aren't convinced yet.

articles.title: Trezor Cuts Its Resellers After Ledger Finds Spy Implant in Crypto Wallets
articles.description: Trezor is ending reseller authorizations on January 1, 2027, after Ledger confirmed that wallets sold by a Southeast Asian retailer carried a hidden implant that sent out users' recovery phrases.

articles.title: AI Powered PlayStation Crack Could Let You Play GTA 6 on PC at Launch
articles.description: AnyPS5 is working to get any PS5 game running natively on PC—and gamers are hoping it'll work for the next instalment of Grand Theft Auto.

articles.title: Ledger Finds LTE Implant That Stole Recovery Phrases in Suspected $86M Drain
articles.description: Ledger says the hidden chip reads the 24-word phrase off the screen during setup, leaving the Secure Element and its software untouched.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Bitcoin Gets Spooked as ‘Uptober’ Lets Down
articles.description: Crypto majors are red, alts are down bad and onchain is facing capitulation. This was not the ‘Uptober’ that was promised…

articles.title: UK Moves Closer to Keeping $5B Bitcoin Haul After High Court Ruling
articles.description: A judge ruled that Chinese law should govern fraud victims' claims to the 61,000 BTC seized from Zhimin Qian, in a blow to the claimants.

articles.title: ‘Leave’: Crypto Backlash Over French Proposal to Report Wallets Over $112K
articles.description: The proposal would require crypto owners to report holdings over €100,000, sparking concerns following a wave of "wrench attacks" in France.

articles.title: NFT Marketplace Blur to Shut Down Website, Stop New Blend Loans Next Month
articles.description: The shutdown comes as NFT trading volumes have collapsed from their 2021-2022 peak, with market revenue projected at $318 million this year.

articles.title: AI Will Hit 40% of Jobs, IMF Warns. Young People Are First in Line
articles.description: IMF chief Kristalina Georgieva says AI investment is holding global growth near 3%, with Asian chipmakers winning big, while warning of a 'slow-moving tsunami' for young workers.

articles.title: Standard Chartered Will Hold Ripple's Stablecoin in Dubai—And Let Clients Trade With It Without Moving It
articles.description: The bank's Dubai branch now offers custody for Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin and plans a link with LMAX that lets institutions post it as trading collateral while the coins stay put.

articles.title: Meta's New Muse Wonder Finally Puts Zuckerberg in the Frontier AI Race
articles.description: Meta's new flagship beats GPT-6 Astra and Claude on memory, legal and marathon coding tests, but independent rankings still put Anthropic's Opus 5.5 on top.

articles.title: From GTA V on iPhone to Free Photoshop: This AI Tool Is Upending Software
articles.description: REA, a free toolkit that hands AI agents the keys to reverse engineering, crossed 100,000 GitHub stars in a week as AI-decompiled game mods, console ports, and Adobe clones flood the internet.

articles.title: Solana Treasury Firm DeFi Development Keeps Buying SOL as CHAD Preferred Stock Hits Record
articles.description: The Nasdaq-listed company now holds about 2.59 million SOL, but its weekly purchases keep shrinking.

articles.title: Ripple-Backed Evernorth Hits Nasdaq Holding 473 Million XRP Worth Far Less Than It Paid
articles.description: Evernorth's XRPN shares began trading Monday after its SPAC merger closed, but 80% of SPAC investors cashed out first and its XRP stash is worth roughly 40% less than at signing.

articles.title: Bitcoin Spooked? Crypto Fear and Greed Index Drops to Pre-Rally August Lows
articles.description: The Crypto Fear and Greed Index has dropped to 56 from an August peak of 82, as oil, bond yields, and ETF outflows hit Bitcoin in October.
